# Ethan Flow — Software Engineer

> Ethan Flow builds systems that take work in, plan it, ship it, and learn — so he can focus on what is worth building and get outside.

## About

Ethan Flow is a software engineer based in Oregon. He earned a B.S. in Computer Science from Oregon State University in 2025. He is the founder of Jedidiah Digital.

## What he builds

Systems that run themselves: work comes in, gets planned, built by agents, checked, shipped, and learned from — without someone pushing every step.

## Timeline

- 2022: JavaScript · React · Node
- 2023: Python · C/C++ · SQL
- 2024: Next.js · first AI integrations
- 2025: B.S. CS, Oregon State · Go
- 2026: agents write it. I build the system.

## Skills (fluent)

typescript, python, postgres, go, aws, docker

## Camp stories (summaries)

- Faith: Baptized at 13, wandered, then made it real. Faith comes first.
- Education: Spanish immersion, IB, pre-med, then CS at Oregon State.
- Family: My wife, my mom, a sister who flies planes, and 15 cousins.
- Life: Born in Oregon. Hiking, food, and almost anything new.
